5uka_blyat: Isidor Blyat walked into N-F20 on Day 12 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Isidor Blyat's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
Isidor Blyat traded a frozen apple for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Isidor Blyat waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.
A second spoon disappeared. Isidor Blyat searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.
_mysterious.mountainman_: Ulrich "Brick" Mountainman came up the line with a rosary of rough beads and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Ulrich "Brick" Mountainman was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.

Ulrich "Spark" Abdullahh carried Ulrich "Brick" Mountainman's rifle all the way up to the Hanging Bridge after Brick twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to. Ulrich "Brick" Mountainman got a letter today. The handwriting was shaky, but the news was good. The letter went inside the helmet, for luck.
bijan_zzz: Nils "Mud" Zzz came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

A single shot from across the wire hit Nils "Mud" Zzz in the thigh at R-R11. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Walter "Button" Jmw of the Concord (@jmw094). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Nils "Mud" Zzz fell at R-R11 and never moved again. Shot by Walter "Button" Jmw of the Concord (@jmw094).
Dietrich Zzz had heard about Nils "Mud" Zzz's courage. At R-R11, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Dietrich Zzz fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Karel Man was gravely wounded. Dietrich Zzz fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at R-R11. Before dawn Emil Kevinkukhta walked into it, badly wounded. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Dietrich Zzz helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

The water jacket hissed as Dietrich Zzz fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Jonas "Owl" Askey was grazed. A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Dietrich Zzz aimed just below it. Rafael Schildbroete was grazed.
Dietrich Zzz's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
Dietrich Zzz checked every ammunition belt by lamplight. One bad cartridge was enough to make him start the whole inspection again.
The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Dietrich Zzz was faster. Arno Glas was grazed.
A second spoon disappeared. Dietrich Zzz searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.
chanley87: The draft reached V-F18 on Day 14. Felix Chanley was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Machine-gun fire swept V-F18. Felix Chanley took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Albin "Ash" Thehassand of the Concord (@thehassand). The bearers reached Felix Chanley at V-F18 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Albin "Ash" Thehassand of the Concord (@thehassand).
The House of Chanley sent Quentin "Smokes" Chanley after Felix Chanley. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Quentin "Smokes" Chanley and Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
cnfilip77: Nobody asked Yann Cnfilip why he came. Nobody in T-F9 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Yann Cnfilip saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at T-F9 and fired once. Lucien "Brick" Rykaczewski was grazed. A shell burst directly over T-F9. Yann Cnfilip was found under the duckboards, alive, but only just. The orderlies scrubbed a bed in the hospital dugout and called for Yann Cnfilip. He was asleep before they set him down. Yann Cnfilip's fever broke in the night. The orderly checked the chart twice and smiled for the first time in a week. A letter from home reached Yann Cnfilip before dusk. Yann Cnfilip read it twice and slept a little easier. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Yann Cnfilip folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Yann Cnfilip slept most of the day. When he woke, someone had left a cup of tea on the crate beside the bed. A letter from home reached Yann Cnfilip before dusk. Yann Cnfilip read it twice and slept a little easier.

Yann Cnfilip came back from hospital with a clean shirt. The men admired it from a respectful distance. A letter from home reached Yann Cnfilip before dusk. Yann Cnfilip read it twice and slept a little easier. Orders assigned Yann Cnfilip to work as a chaplain. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

The east wind brought the smell of the other trenches: smoke, lime and somebody's cooking. Yann Cnfilip was hungry and furious about it. A letter from home reached Yann Cnfilip before dusk. Yann Cnfilip read it twice and slept a little easier.
Yann Cnfilip was asked to arrange a gathering for men who did not want a sermon. He asked what they did want and wrote down the answers.
Yann Cnfilip was on watch at T-F9 when the night raid hit. The men found Yann Cnfilip at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Viktor Eleisson of the Concord (@kyrie_eleisson).
Oskar "Hollow" Cnfilip took the same post at T-F9 where Yann Cnfilip stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
dale.coop: Matthias Coop came up the line with a stub of a pencil and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud. The transfer made Matthias Coop a sniper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Matthias Coop could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Matthias Coop had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Karel Dalton was grazed. A letter from home reached Matthias Coop before dusk. Matthias Coop read it twice and slept a little easier.

Across the wire at Saint-Ash crossroads, Anselm Godden of the Concord held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Matthias Coop of the Hegemony held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.' A letter from home reached Matthias Coop before dusk. Matthias Coop read it twice and slept a little easier.

Matthias Coop and the spotter took turns with the telescope for half a day, talking only in numbers. At the last number Matthias Coop fired. Marek Kha was badly wounded. Matthias Coop was hit in the forearm at P-F20. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Marek Kha of the Concord (@niko2kha). A letter from home reached Matthias Coop before dusk. Matthias Coop read it twice and slept a little easier. Matthias Coop bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.' Matthias Coop was invited to the Officers' Mess for keeping the front supplied. The colonel poured a real coffee and raised his cup: 'The front does not forget its friends.' A dachshund wandered in from no man's land at dawn, wet and hungry. It chose Matthias Coop. Matthias Coop gave it a name: Crumb.

Matthias Coop came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. A letter from home reached Matthias Coop before dusk. Matthias Coop read it twice and slept a little easier.

No rifles, only shovels and knives. Matthias Coop dropped into the Concord trench by a dugout door and met Oskar Kha coming out. It was over in seconds. (@niko2kha) Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Matthias Coop only heard boots on the duckboards at P-F20, then nothing but pain. Raider: Roland Alex of the Concord (@alex_h5315). A letter for Matthias Coop came with a pressed flower inside. Matthias Coop showed the flower to nobody.
domgas_1: Day 8: Dietrich "Spark" Domgas reached R-S16 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Dietrich "Spark" Domgas asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Dietrich "Spark" Domgas watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

The mud froze hard overnight. For one morning Dietrich "Spark" Domgas could walk on top of it, like a man walking on water. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Dietrich "Spark" Domgas answered to number 558. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Dietrich "Spark" Domgas read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Dietrich "Spark" Domgas had just lit a cigarette at R-S16 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Walter Davebowlton of the Hegemony (@davebowlton).

Dietrich "Spark" Domgas was hit through the stomach at R-S16. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Gideon Alt of the Hegemony (@just.luke.alt). Dietrich "Spark" Domgas has a bed in the hospital dugout at last, between a man who prays and a man who swears. He says it is a fair balance. Dietrich "Spark" Domgas seemed to get better for a day. Then he did not. He died in the ward with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts under his pillow.
Leopold Domgas joined R-S16 under the shadow of Dietrich "Spark" Domgas's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Leopold Domgas found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning.

Leopold Domgas fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Teodor Raider, now gravely wounded. A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Leopold Domgas aimed a step ahead and fired: Pavel "Crow" Aiden, badly wounded.

A bullet found Leopold Domgas at R-S16, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg of the Hegemony (@drkevlagg). Leopold Domgas stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-S16. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Albin "Lucky" Drkevlagg of the Hegemony (@drkevlagg).
The House of Domgas sent another. Bram Domgas, uncle of Leopold Domgas, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
faccio.stefano: The draft reached R-C10 on Day 9. Gustav "Mud" Stefano was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Gustav "Mud" Stefano let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Valentin "Shadow" Aloofcardina was grazed. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Gustav "Mud" Stefano read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A clear shot from R-C10. Gustav "Mud" Stefano badly wounded Karel Check and slid back down below the parapet. Gustav "Mud" Stefano got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 607. The men who came later will ask about it. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-C10 with the rations. Gustav "Mud" Stefano ate while listening to the revised orders.
Gustav "Mud" Stefano moved his hide three times today. Snipers who stay in one place do not stay anywhere for long.
Gustav "Mud" Stefano lay in the ruins of Grey Mill from dawn to dusk. He did not fire once. That is also a kind of victory.
A loose strip of canvas snapped above Gustav "Mud" Stefano's bunk. He tied it down and received thanks from six apparently sleeping men.
Gustav "Mud" Stefano rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Quentin Zanetaylor was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land.

Gustav "Mud" Stefano had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Ulrich Internetmang was grazed. The men at R-C10 heard Gustav "Mud" Stefano call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni of the Hegemony (@zaboravljeninemanjic). A single shot at R-C10. Gustav "Mud" Stefano sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni of the Hegemony (@zaboravljeninemanjic).
The House of Stefano sent another. Viktor Stefano, brother of Gustav "Mud" Stefano, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
george_jackson2004: Dietrich Jackson came from Oakmere, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Dietrich Jackson received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on.
On Day 3, Verdel Ridge passed to the Concord. Dietrich Jackson wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Dietrich Jackson spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
Dietrich Jackson got a letter from Clara. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.

Rain washed the chalk names from the trench signs. Dietrich Jackson spent the evening directing strangers past the same junction. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached R-F10 with the rations. Dietrich Jackson ate while listening to the revised orders.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F10 and grazed Dietrich Jackson's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Marek Ditrih of the Hegemony (@ditrih_88).
Dietrich Jackson no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Dietrich Jackson wrote back to Clara and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.
Dietrich Jackson sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Dietrich Jackson wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

No post for Dietrich Jackson this week. He checks the sack anyway, every day, and pretends he was only looking for tobacco. Grey Mill is lost. Dietrich Jackson heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
For keeping his head when others lost theirs at Saint-Ash crossroads, Dietrich Jackson was promoted to Lance Corporal.
A parcel from Clara: socks, a cake gone hard as a brick, and a pressed flower. Dietrich Jackson ate the cake and kept the flower in a book with the last pages torn out's place.
A recruit asked Dietrich Jackson how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
Dietrich Jackson tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.

The Hegemony raiders came over at R-F10 in the middle of the night. Dietrich Jackson met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Henrik Sergiootd of the Hegemony (@sergiootd).
The House of Jackson sent another. Felix Jackson, uncle of Dietrich Jackson, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
gmt_zhai: Yann Zhai reached R-R3 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Yann Zhai looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

A beetle crawled across Yann Zhai's sleeve during the long wait. He could do nothing about it without giving away the position. The clerk counted the names twice. Yann Zhai is number 957 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is lost. Yann Zhai heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

A single shot from across the wire hit Yann Zhai in the thigh at R-R3. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Dietrich Marcusho of the Hegemony (@marcusho64). Yann Zhai moved to a new hide at R-R3 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Nils "Bones" Martinvajda, gravely wounded.
The bearers moved Yann Zhai's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.
A medic stopped by Yann Zhai's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Yann Zhai had gone back to R-R3.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Yann Zhai read a theatre review while peeling supper.
Yann Zhai raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-R3. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin of the Hegemony (@dependentkink_____).
hexofdex: Day 10: Dorian Hexofdex reached P-F20 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Dorian Hexofdex tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Port Abel. Every version sounded like the ration bell. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In P-F20, Dorian Hexofdex listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Dorian Hexofdex ate two helpings anyway.
Dorian Hexofdex stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of P-F20, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either.

A bullet struck Dorian Hexofdex below the ribs at P-F20. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Otto Chuckemuckle of the Hegemony (@chuckemuckle). Dorian Hexofdex was killed on watch at P-F20. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Otto Chuckemuckle of the Hegemony (@chuckemuckle).
A letter came with Henrik Hexofdex: "I am Dorian Hexofdex's brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Henrik Hexofdex lost a boot in the trench. Lucien Knoppu found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.
The dugout roof dripped into Henrik Hexofdex's mug. He moved the mug. The roof found another way.
kurlkale: Felix "Bones" Kurlkale reached S-C11 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Felix "Bones" Kurlkale counted the steps of the Concord sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Leopold "Brick" Moovin never saw the shovel coming. (@da_moovin) Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Felix "Bones" Kurlkale landed next to Tobias Lakam in the Concord trench. Only Felix "Bones" Kurlkale climbed back out. (@kil.lakam20) The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-C11 changed before the cheering ended. Felix "Bones" Kurlkale shouldered another load. A letter from home reached Felix "Bones" Kurlkale before dusk. Felix "Bones" Kurlkale read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix "Bones" Kurlkale won a week of rum at cards from a lance corporal in S-C11. The lance corporal wants a rematch. A letter from home reached Felix "Bones" Kurlkale before dusk. Felix "Bones" Kurlkale read it twice and slept a little easier. Felix "Bones" Kurlkale got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 927. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Felix "Bones" Kurlkale watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Felix "Bones" Kurlkale lent Zeno Jacobg a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'. A letter from home reached Felix "Bones" Kurlkale before dusk. Felix "Bones" Kurlkale read it twice and slept a little easier.

A borrowed pencil wore down while Felix "Bones" Kurlkale was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first. A letter from home reached Felix "Bones" Kurlkale before dusk. Felix "Bones" Kurlkale read it twice and slept a little easier.

Wiring party. Felix "Bones" Kurlkale held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at S-C11, and everyone came back. A letter from home reached Felix "Bones" Kurlkale before dusk. Felix "Bones" Kurlkale read it twice and slept a little easier.

Rematch. Felix "Bones" Kurlkale lost everything he won, plus a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts. The whole dugout watched. A letter from home reached Felix "Bones" Kurlkale before dusk. Felix "Bones" Kurlkale read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix "Bones" Kurlkale tried to remember the price of a loaf in Coldwater. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought. A short letter reached Felix "Bones" Kurlkale: everyone is well, the dog misses you. Felix "Bones" Kurlkale read the part about the dog twice.
list.e.r: After 11 days of war, U-F2 had a place for everything. On Day 11, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Clement List.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Clement List changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
Clement List remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Clement List reached up to fix a sandbag at U-F2 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway.
Clement List is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Clement List and Leopold "Rabbit" Dfeeney made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
manny_lopez.18: The quartermaster asked Otto Lopez to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Otto Lopez shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Gustav Vandahinten, was badly wounded. Grey Mill is lost. Otto Lopez heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Otto Lopez worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Otto Lopez aimed a step ahead and fired: Nils "Bones" Dominiclong, badly wounded.
Otto Lopez cut Florian Kurkalubos's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Otto Lopez waited for that to change. When it did, Otto "Smokes" Dominiclong was grazed.
Otto Lopez began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
prime_ofchile_o7: Cyril "Crow" Ofchile came from Millbank, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Cyril "Crow" Ofchile splinted a broken leg with a rifle and two belts. The patient asked if he was a real doctor. He said yes. He was lying.
Wind kept turning the pages of Cyril "Crow" Ofchile's letter. He held them down with a biscuit and finished with crumbs in the ink.

A sniper's bullet hit Cyril "Crow" Ofchile at P-F22. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Felix Barringarms of the Concord (@tac_sloth_barringarms). Cyril "Crow" Ofchile was hit at P-F22 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Felix Barringarms of the Concord (@tac_sloth_barringarms).
Arno "Parson" Ofchile had heard about Cyril "Crow" Ofchile's courage. At P-F22, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Arno "Parson" Ofchile (Hegemony) shouted a challenge across to Severin "Mud" Kid (Concord) at the Hanging Bridge. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.
realvirtuality: Tobias Realvirtuali came up the line with a key to a house that is no longer there and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Tobias Realvirtuali stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. A letter from home reached Tobias Realvirtuali before dusk. Tobias Realvirtuali read it twice and slept a little easier. Orders came through: Tobias Realvirtuali is a rifleman now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a key to a house that is no longer there.

Tobias Realvirtuali drew a map of Severin "Doc" Justinsoups's hometown from Doc's stories. Doc says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere. A letter from home reached Tobias Realvirtuali before dusk. Tobias Realvirtuali read it twice and slept a little easier. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Tobias Realvirtuali watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Tobias Realvirtuali fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Cyril "Spark" Evader, grazed. A letter from home reached Tobias Realvirtuali before dusk. Tobias Realvirtuali read it twice and slept a little easier.

Fresh from training, Tobias Realvirtuali still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Benedikt Clintxix, grazed. A letter from home reached Tobias Realvirtuali before dusk. Tobias Realvirtuali read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A round came through the loophole Tobias Realvirtuali was watching at T-F22 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. A letter from home reached Tobias Realvirtuali before dusk. Tobias Realvirtuali read it twice and slept a little easier.

The bearers moved Tobias Realvirtuali's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule. A letter from home reached Tobias Realvirtuali before dusk. Tobias Realvirtuali read it twice and slept a little easier.

Tobias Realvirtuali survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at T-F22, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post. A letter for Tobias Realvirtuali came with a pressed flower inside. Tobias Realvirtuali showed the flower to nobody.
robbie_jackson420: By the time Edmund Jackson reached V-F16, the war was 11 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Edmund Jackson wrote to his mother, who writes every Sunday that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Edmund Jackson spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
Edmund Jackson opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Edmund Jackson as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
Edmund Jackson fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Henrik Bohdanleki, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.
Edmund Jackson had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Norbert Caique, gravely wounded.
samot0423: Roland Samot reached T-F21 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Roland Samot wrote to his mother, who writes every Sunday that night and said only: 'We will take it back.' A letter from home reached Roland Samot before dusk. Roland Samot read it twice and slept a little easier.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Roland Samot read a theatre review while peeling supper. A letter from home reached Roland Samot before dusk. Roland Samot read it twice and slept a little easier. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Roland Samot read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

The section held a competition for the worst joke. Roland Samot won before reaching the end of his entry. A letter from home reached Roland Samot before dusk. Roland Samot read it twice and slept a little easier. Roland Samot transferred to the machine gunners. The men in T-F21 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Roland Samot fired, and Florian Kyrenhaong was grazed. A letter from home reached Roland Samot before dusk. Roland Samot read it twice and slept a little easier.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Pavel Viaenegilles stood up to sing louder, and Roland Samot fired. Pavel Viaenegilles was badly wounded. The singing stopped.
Roland Samot saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at T-F21 and fired once. Jonas Viaenegilles was gravely wounded.

At T-F21 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Roland Samot turned around and took a shovel blow. Otto "Smokes" Thanbrown of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Otto "Smokes" Thanbrown of the Hegemony (@e_thanbrown). The letter for Roland Samot had been in the rain somewhere along the way. Roland Samot dried it by the stove, page by page.
tru_og_fokai: Dietrich Fokai unpacked a rosary of rough beads at S-R14. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

Dietrich Fokai saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-R14 and fired once. Henrik Somka was grazed. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Dietrich Fokai wrote to his mother, who writes every Sunday that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Dietrich Fokai changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument. The clerk counted the names twice. Dietrich Fokai is number 937 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Dietrich Fokai looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Dietrich Fokai added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
Dietrich Fokai wrote a letter for Henrik Addddamsss's mother, because Henrik could not find the words. Henrik signed it.
Dietrich Fokai found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
Dietrich Fokai was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Benedikt Clan was badly wounded.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Dietrich Fokai shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Zeno Midnight, was grazed.
willdan_theman: Felix "Parson" Theman came up the line with a cracked shaving mirror and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Emil "Spark" Austin and Felix "Parson" Theman compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house. A letter from home reached Felix "Parson" Theman before dusk. Felix "Parson" Theman read it twice and slept a little easier.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Felix "Parson" Theman pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
Felix "Parson" Theman and Hugo Juggernaut cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
Felix "Parson" Theman kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
